description.en: The DeepSeek Harness that rewrites itself.
description.zh: 会自己改造自己的 DeepSeek Harness。

title.en: DSHRSI: the harness that rewrites itself
title.zh: DSHRSI：会自己改造自己的 Harness

description.en: Watches every session for trouble that repeats: a command this machine does not have, a correction you had to give, a turn that ends without checking its work. When it finds one, it has the session model write a small piece of harness code for it, checks that code, and mounts it into the running session; what works is kept for later sessions. Adaptations belong to one of three layers (this machine, you, this project), and project ones can be written into the repository under .dsh-rsi and shared. In the Web UI, a "RSI" badge in the session header and a "Harness adapted to you" pill under the message box show what is at work; type /rsi for the full account. Writing an adaptation costs one extra model request on the session's own model. Nothing leaves the machine. Adaptations can refuse or question a tool call and add text for the model; they cannot allow what the harness would refuse. Switching the plugin off unmounts every adaptation and leaves the library on disk.
description.zh: 盯着每一次会话里反复出现的麻烦：这台机器上没有的命令、你不得不说第二遍的纠正、没验证就收工的一轮。发现之后，让会话里的模型当场写一小段 Harness 代码，校验通过后挂进正在运行的会话；有效的留给以后的会话。适配分三层（这台机器、你、这个项目），项目层的可以写进仓库的 .dsh-rsi 目录随项目共享。在 Web 界面里，会话标题栏的 “RSI” 徽标和输入框下方的 “Harness 已为你适配” 状态条显示正在生效的适配；输入 /rsi 查看完整情况。每写一个适配会多用一次当前会话模型的请求。数据不离开本机。适配可以拒绝或要求确认一次工具调用，可以给模型加说明；不能放行 Harness 本来会拒绝的操作。关掉插件会卸下所有适配，磁盘上的适配库保留。
